overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: a quorum of the Committee spoke at a Select Board meeting, but the matter was outside the Committee's jurisdiction, so it was not deliberation.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged a quorum of the Community Preservation Committee attended and spoke at a posted Select Board meeting on membership, deliberating outside a posted Committee meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Here, although the Select Board requested and the Committee members provided input regarding the proposal to designate a seat on the Committee for a representative of the Affordable Housing Trust, ultimately the Select Board alone has the authority to make such a change and to appoint the members of the Committee.
